query:
UPDATE workout_sets SET
             actual_kg = $2::float8::numeric(6, 2),
             actual_reps = $3,
             completed_at = CASE
                 WHEN $4 THEN COALESCE(completed_at, LEAST($5, now()))
                 ELSE NULL
             END,
             client_updated_at = $5
         WHERE id = $1 AND (client_updated_at IS NULL OR client_updated_at <= $5)
